name: One season map (a member's)
description: THE MEMBER'S COPY of soma-pub-maps-get: the same statement with the session's claims, so a private season answers to its participants, its season admins and platform admins (season_visible), and to anyone else exactly as the public route does. Uncached, because the answer depends on the viewer. PUBLIC: one board of a season, with the board itself and every time it was enabled or disabled -- which is the record of when it was in play, since a live season's standings were earned on whatever was enabled at the time. The board is returned exactly as stored, for the viewer's own component to draw; nothing here reads inside it.
